notes.title: Worms: The Board Game I Final 48 Hours!
notes.content:
Nutters! 🥜 There will be no ‘Sudden Death’ when the time runs out on the Kickstarter campaign for Worms: The Board Game, having achieved its funding goal faster than a Jet Pack wearing Worm!

Worms: The Board Game is a hilarious game of strategy, chance and exploding Sheep! Bring the nostalgia, fun and utter mayhem of Worms to life- right on your tabletop.

[h3][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/manticgames/worms-the-board-game]🔗 Worms: The Board Game Kickstarter Page[/url][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18939040/f6c1f9a11c7bcf2194b82c1a758ae4842bed0169.png[/img]

A lot has happened since the Kickstarter launched, including lots of daily reveals, information about features and surprise additions and here’s a brief overview of some of them!

But before we get into this, we want to showcase our latest addition to Worms: The Board Game... [b]Professor Worminkle from Worms 4: Mayhem![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18939040/22c0d26f46144dfc5f3eac8926b6d9c5b24a98bf.png[/img]
Alongside this daily reveal, here's more information around Worms: The Board games newest features:

[h3]Sound Effects & Timer App [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18939040/0bd87c4323964b33699163667b32c2f5d7dd7345.png[/img]

A highly requested item from the community during the Kickstarter as been on incorporating the familiar speech and sound effects from in-game. Well, full details are still be confirmed, but there are now plans to include a range of audio to really bring your tabletop experience to life! To put everything in the same place, plans also include a game-style countdown timer for those who want to play with some added pressure, and the hilarity of watching your opponents make silly mistakes as the seconds tick down...

[h3]Closer Look: Sentry Guns[/h3]
Sentry Guns are a little more complex than most other weapons, so come with the card shown below, a reference card, and tokens for deploying on the map. Represented by a token, Sentry Guns count as a 'Thing' (for the purposes of filling a hex) and are immovable once deployed. If they take damage, they are destroyed.

[b][i]How do they work?[/i][/b] Sentry Gun tokens are marked with an arrow, so when deployed they face out of one side of their hex (their facing cannot be changed). If a Thing moves to a hex within the Sentry Gun's line of fire, it is damaged.

This is an excellent way of restricting your opponent's ability to position well as they must deal with the Sentry Gun first, or restrict their (safe) movement in the meantime. Just beware that the Sentry Gun doesn't discriminate between friendly and enemy Worms entering its line of fire, so make sure to have a plan before you deploy one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18939040/92198fe07be8f2f61ff899f73677944e1bec883a.png[/img]
[h3]Let's Talk Superweapons[/h3]
For those of you who don't know, these are rare and powerful weapons that can be used to press home an advantage or turn the tide if your team of Worms are in a desperate situation. They can have a big impact if used well, but expect plenty of laughter from your opponents if you make a bad call and something backfires!

These weapon cards have a yellow header so you instantly know you've picked up something special from a crate...now make sure to keep a straight face.

There are a good range of these cards, from today's Buffalo of Lies to the Concrete Donkey (Hee-Haw!), the Holy Hand Grenade (Halleluja!), the Priceless Vase...and more. There are enough in the deck to give you plenty of variety, but few enough that you'll get a thrill when you draw one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18939040/b2f5db2f7838acd2d64fb87fc611ce8ae522c4ec.png[/img]
[h3]Timeline[/h3]
The team want to extend their thanks to the 4,500+ backers to the project so far and are so excited the most iconic of wriggly critters will battle away on tables around the world.

The plan is for pledges to be delivered in August 2024 - however, the exact timing may change and there is always the potential for delay with any products produced in China. Backers will be kept updated through the process.

notes.title: Worms: The Board Game - Back today on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Oi Nutters! 🥜 Ready for mayhem, explosions, and HUGE nostalgia?

After our announcement of [b]Worms: The Board Game[/b] and our partnership with Mantic Games back in June, we are thrilled to launch the next stage of the project on Kickstarter and showcase more Worms: The Board Game with you all!

[h3]Worms: The Board Game Timeline[/h3]
The plan is for pledges to be delivered in August 2024 - however, the exact timing may change and there is always the potential for delay with any products produced in China. Backers will be kept updated through the process.
[h2]Daily Reveals:[/h2]
Over on our Kickstarter page, fan-favourite additions to Worms: The Board Game will be revealed every day! Here's the inside scoop for our first one:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18939040/1e2df688b7a515f03e343c174062cf1b236486b5.png[/img]
Don't get maaaaaad- get even with one of the Worms series' most iconic weapons! 
Want to see more daily reveals and other explosive inclusions coming to Worms: The Board Game? Ewe'll be mad not to check them out... over on our Kickstarter Page! 

[h2][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/manticgames/worms-the-board-game]Worms: The Board Game Kickstarter Page[/url][/h2]

You can also follow Worms on Twitter to keep up to date with future daily reveals! 
🔗 https://twitter.com/WormsTeam17

Today we also have a special Q&A, with the man behind the miniatures of Worms: The Board Game: Luigi Terzi!

[h2]Q&A With Our Sculptor: Luigi Terzi[/h2]

[u]Hi Luigi! Tell us a little about your background in sculpting.[/u]
I started sculpting 10 years ago, but first started out in graphic design. After working with legendary game designer Alessio Cavatore I asked if he knew anyone searching for an illustrator and a sculptor, and that’s how I came to meet Ronnie and his team at Mantic Games!

Through the years I have done work for Warlord Games, Modiphius, Fantasy Flight, Steamforged, Wyrd, & Wizkids. I have also sculpted large-scale models for companies like Sideshow and Figurama.

[u]How did you feel when asked to work on Worms?[/u]
My very first thought was ‘that’s going to be a lot of fun’, and it has been!

[u]Are you a fan of the Worms video games?[/u]
I played them a lot before raising a family. Back then I also loved Wipeout, Tekken and Colin McRae Rally – so maybe you can guess my age from this list!

[u]What are the challenges with sculpting these characters?[/u]
The most difficult thing is making the Worms look like they have paused mid-action! They have to be very expressive. It’s all about combining fun facial expressions with a cool pose that works. Finally, they need to have enough variety so they will look great together on the tabletop.

[u]What was the best thing about this project?[/u]
Having the chance to do something totally different from anything else I’ve worked on! Working with different design styles really helps to keep my creativity fresh.

[u]Do you have a favourite worm that you’ve sculpted for the campaign?[/u]
Do I have to pick just one? I have a few, my top 3 are: the worm with a sheep, the worm with a vase, and (*spoiler alert*) at first place is the disco worm – he looks fantastic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18939040/e3e82f0b1c9d98c044a4828ab1a1f23b8bc669e5.png[/img]

Thanks Luigi – it’s been a pleasure chatting with you, and thanks for all your work on Worms: The Board Game!

notes.title: Worms Rumble Is Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Worms Rumble has just landed here on Steam and is available to purchase, download and play! Don your jet pack and thrust yourself into the first ever real time Worms game! Take on epic 32 player battle royale or deathmatch modes right now! Plus get into the action quickly with matches with crossplay with other platforms.

[b]Watch the action packed launch trailer here:[/b]

[previewyoutube=pbNWUMnC328;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's some of the action you can expect of Worms Rumble:

[h3]3 Modes[/h3]

Take on the battle royale mode in Last Worm Standing or with 2 friends in the Squads mode. If that's not your cup of tea you can roll into the death match mode and hone your skills whilst respawning straight back into the action if you stand too close to a blossoming banana bomb.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xiICMPv9gISXe8cLcH/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]32 player transforming maps[/h3]

As of launch there are 3 maps designed full of funny references, iconic landmarks and strategic areas to get the upper hand on opponents. The maps can also have the chance to transform mid way through the battle with missile launches and even portals opening to shake up the match.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/W4BYuts2fmQjktoVvP/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]Equip a whole host of powerful classic and new weaponry![/h3]

Wield classic weaponry from the Worms series, like the devastating holy hand grenade and also equip yourself with completely new guns like the projectile bouncing plasma launcher.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ukpf5NU3Knkrjm5poS/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]Customise your worm to the max[/h3]

Don't look like a basic worm... well actually you can but if you want to really get ahead on the worm walkway then there's so many options open to you! Felt like a dinosaur on the outside but on the inside you were worm... don't worry we've got the outfit for that! Plus, match many accessories to get a completely custom look. You will get xp in the matches to unlock new tiers of outfits and customisations to how you are presented in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38203235/9431751ffdbf709119affa4f354e58c8fc644fb4.png[/img]

[h3]Don't wriggle around the maps[/h3]

In Worms Rumble, movement is key! Roll around the map to speed up and also scale walls with extra jumps but be careful as you'll need to carefully manage your stamina! Also, find classic equipment to give you an extra edge like the jetpack and utility belt which can take you to the skies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38203235/b71808fd83c421602b5b43859929000a51938ea1.gif[/img]

[h3]Come up with unique ways to play and gain the edge[/h3]

Come up with unique tactics to gain the edge on your enemies whether that be returning a foes rocket with your baseball bat or shielding a teammate to be revived and become the 'Last Worm Standing'

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bdh4zAw.gif[/img]

[h1]Join the action now:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1186040/Worms_Rumble/

[h3]This is just the beginning![/h3]

We hope everyone has an amazing time jetpacking, grappling or rolling around the map and blasting foes to become the last worm standing! This is only the beginning for Worms Rumble! New content, events, customisations and much more are planned for the game with regular updates planned.

notes.title: Worms Rumble - Launching December & Open Beta November 6th!
notes.content:
Hey everyone

We’re super excited to share with you that Worms Rumble will be launching on Steam this December! 

Worms Rumble is the next instalment in the Worms franchise! For the first time ever in a Worms game you’ll be able to jump into intense, real-time battles with upto 32-players! 

You can squad up with friends or fight solo in different game modes from Deathmatch to Last Worm Standing. Worms Rumble will feature a variety of fan-favourite weapons from past games as well as new additions to the franchise for you to get your wormy hands on! 

So to celebrate this awesome news we’ve put together a new trailer for you that reveals a new, never before seen level as well as some new mobility items…

[previewyoutube=YCSWCEAgRzQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Let's take a look at some of the new trailer reveals shall we!


[h1]New Mobility Gadgets[/h1]

Mobility tools play a huge part in any Worms game and today we’re revealing two of these tools that will be available in Worms Rumble for you to swing and soar through the skies with. (Yes, for those wondering, there’s more.)

As we all know, the ability to move around the map in a quick and stylish fashion is a key Worms feature and that’s no different in Rumble, so let’s take a look at what you’ll be getting to grips with:


[b]The Grappling Gun[/b]

A close cousin of the Ninja Rope, the Grappling Gun rewards skillful worms with unrivaled mobility and speed, allowing you to swiftly navigate through the map, change your momentum and even access hard to reach locations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38203235/625ea63abe431a54d4cb607cd2a9ee88a4382f3e.gif[/img]

Worms that become comfortable with this tool will also find many useful applications for the Grappling Gun during a firefight too…


[b]The Jetpack[/b]

The classic Jetpack is back and ready to take your worm to the skies!

This tool is perfect for use in open spaces and larger rooms, giving you the ability to rain down destruction from above or fly above the carnage of an enemy Banana Bomb. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38203235/b71808fd83c421602b5b43859929000a51938ea1.gif[/img]

Perfect for ambushing enemies from above or quickly escaping a losing battle, Jetpack users should be aware that whilst highly mobile they are vulnerable to precision weapons whilst hovering, so unless you’re wanting to visit the respawn screen try and avoid that!


[b]Bonus mobility move - Rocket Jumping![/b]

Yes, for the first time ever you’ll be able to rocket jump in Worms (without ending your turn anyway!). 

This high risk - high reward technique speaks for itself, so we’ll leave it to you, our brave players, to figure that one out in battle…


[h1]Crossplay Open Beta - Starting November 6th![/h1]

As existing Worms players you know Worms better than anyone. For that reason we’d love to invite you to try out Worms Rumble absolutely free from November 6th - November 8th in our crossplay open beta.

We know real-time Worms is very different to our turn-based history and that many of you will have questions on how it plays, what it is like and whether your experience with the turn-based classics will carry over to the real-time world. The Worms Rumble beta is the perfect time to have those questions answered, whilst also seeing how we’ve taken what makes Worms, well Worms, and crafted it into a real-time experience.

The Dev Team will be playing during the beta and be closely watching your feedback too, so it’s a brilliant time to share your thoughts directly with the team… And even lob a Banana Bomb at them! 

With no sign-up required you’ll be able to jump straight into the action alone or with friends as you clash with players both here on Steam and on console. 

We’ll be revealing more about the beta over the coming weeks, so keep an eye on the [url=https://twitter.com/WormsTeam17]Worms Twitter[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1186040]Worms Rumble Steam Community[/url] page to stay in the loop!


[b]Pre-order & Digital Deluxe Editions[/b]

Just like its peers, Worms Rumble will be packed full of cosmetics for you to customise your worm and make them unique. 

Some of these will be available from the start, with lots more being unlocked by just playing the game however you like and progressing through the ranks, using your preferred weapons and completing special challenges.

As a special thank you to those that pre-order Worms Rumble here on Steam we’ll also be giving them a unique cosmetic pack known as the ‘New Challenger’ bonus pack!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38203235/32361d7d3396f47ff03342e044dc07f74e458276.png[/img]

If you’re a fan of the classics and want to rep your favourite weapons then may we introduce you to the Digital Deluxe Edition that includes the following…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4062916/9359bfae6c5661c4920c90d49c1b50a4448bebbd.jpg[/img]


Here's a first look at the Retro Commando outfit too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4062916/77cb1809a5cf1c9ba3e9143ec16b4798a7376d5e.png[/img]


[h1]Pre-order Worms Rumble Now![/h1]

If you like what you’ve seen you can pre-order Worms Rumble from right now to secure your exclusive cosmetic pack and support us ahead of launch:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1186040/Worms_Rumble/

You can also support us with a Wishlist if you’re not ready to pre-order just yet!

Thank you for taking the time to check out the newest iteration of Worms. We’re excited to share this next step with you and we hope you enjoyed today’s news.

We look forward to chatting about Worms Rumble with you over on the forums and hurling a Holy Hand Grenade or two at you in the beta on November 6th.

See you then!

notes.title: Vote for Overcooked! 2 & Yoku’s Island Express at The Game Awards!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32941731/7652de62b4c6b4d19fb973a57e1afc9520fd7348.jpg[/img]

One of the biggest events in the gaming calendar, [url=https://thegameawards.com/]The Game Awards[/url], is fast approaching and we’re extremely proud to see that not just one but TWO Team17 releases have been nominated for awards this year!

First up, chaotic co-op cooking game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/728880/Overcooked_2/]Overcooked! 2[/url] has been nominated for Best Family Game, while pinball-Metroidvania [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/334940/Yokus_Island_Express/]Yoku’s Island Express[/url] is up for Best Debut Indie Game!

It means so much to the hard-working people at the Team17 studio, as well as our Games Label partners at Ghost Town Games and Villa Gorilla to be recognised in these categories, but we’d be over the moon if they won. Maybe we’re biased, but we think they deserve it!

[b]How you can help![/b]
The Game Awards winners are decided by a mix of independent judges and fan votes, and in the case of Best Debut Indie Game – in which Yoku’s Island Express is running – the category is 100% decided by fans. 

We want to spread the word about these two great games and encourage more people to play them, and we can’t do it without you! So if you’ve played either of these gems and would like to help out then please [url=https://thegameawards.com/awards/]head to The Game Awards website and cast your vote[/url]!

notes.title: Worms W.M.D Release Date and All-Stars Pre-Order Pack Announcement!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/01b52f07f59ec05132eb6136cd28886d8255a50c.jpg[/img]

I want to start by thanking everyone for their support and enthusiasm for Worms W.M.D, it’s been nothing short of amazing. And now I’m super happy to announce that [b]you’ll be able to get your hands on Worms W.M.D when it launches August 23rd[/b]. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/327030/

But that’s not all…

We’re celebrating the launch of Worms W.M.D by gathering up our friends from across gaming for the Worms W.M.D All-Stars Pre-Order.

[h1]All gamers pre-ordering the game before its August 23rd launch will receive the following Worms W.M.D All-Stars content:[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/53fe3101ed7520c111a4f15c4730c2f4cd9ec066.png[/img]
Worms fans worldwide are eager to cause mayhem with the all-new, mega-powerful Tank in Worms W.M.D., but wait until they get their hands on the Rocket League Octane Battle-Car! Soccer meets driving meets Worms. What's not to like? 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/389dc6d93f6775005157aa52d295946876a8c2e4.png[/img]
Use the Goat-on-a-Rope weapon to strike fear into the hearts of your enemies as the goat swings around the gorgeous digitally painted 2D landscapes using its sticky tongue to hone in on them! Laugh maniacally as the homicidal maniac with hooves explodes, turning your opponents’ troops into worm meat! We also have a pretty cool Goat Simulator three mask set. Because, why not?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/398c5a82f34250edaa6f22dfa10085f108579854.png[/img]
It’s Payday time for the worms. Stick it to the man by dressing your invertebrate chums up in the masks that have become iconic for millions of PAYDAY 2 fans around the world and plan your attack looking like a total badass. They’ll never take you alive!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/a8424b93fe3d1c62be3a2d887a6b11046352bc6e.png[/img]
The most outrageous, over-the-top action franchise in videogames, arrives in Worms W.M.D in the form of the Dubstep gun from Saints Row IV. This baby can inflict massive damage whilst making pedestrians (and worms) dance. Yes, dance. Team17 is proud, and slightly nervous, to announce that the Dubstep Gun will be bringing the dance-pocalypse as one of our mounted guns in honour of this awesome weapon.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/85a3d67f49416d5659a0a77a121799ba71374a2e.png[/img]
The free-to-play zombie survival sensation, where millions of users try their best to stay alive, shuffles into Worms W.M.D in search of brains! And in homage to this popular zomb-fest, Worms fans can dress their slimy pals in a three mask set and wage war in an Unturned mission.

[h1]Welcome to a new way to play Worms![/h1]

For the first time ever you’ll be able to adapt to situations on the fly by crafting an assortment of fittingly crazy weapons.

Collecting the brand new crafting crates will give you access to 4 wonderful ingredients to craft your new favourite weapons. Short of ingredients? Dismantle the weapons you don’t plan on using and craft your way to victory!

•             Boggy’s Special Sauce

•             Sticky Donkey Paste

•             Banana Bomb Seeds

•             Tears of a Worm[/b]

[h1]And there’s more![/h1]

Whilst you’re waiting for that friend of yours that takes forever to do anything, you can have your hands busy crafting. Yep, that’s right, Worms W.M.D will let you dismantle and craft weapons during the enemies turn. Which of course means that they’ll likely be crafting during yours.

notes.title: Introducing Worms: Dating Revolution
notes.content:
[img=https://www.team17.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/websitepng3.png]
[h1]The Worms are no stranger to war, but the time has come for them to take to the toughest battlefield of all. The battlefield of love.[/h1]
	
Become a lover, not a fighter in the newest addition to the Worm franchise. After a near death experience being injured on the front lines by Banana Bomb shrapnel you wake up in hospital, Granny looking down on you. A sudden realisation courses through you as you realise there’s more to life that war. 

Set out into Wormville and get your wiggle on as you begin your search for a soulmate. Meet the locals, flirt, date and take on love rivals as you journey your romantic quest. Will you achieve romance, or be a dating Armageddon? Find out in Worms: Dating revolution.

[img=https://www.team17.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/websitepng2.png]
[h1]Featuring exciting features you’ll love such as:[/h1][b]
•	Be the Worm - Create and customize your own unique Worm from over 1 Million variations, no two Worms the same!
•	Woo your love interests in blistering 60fps 1080p!
•	Multiple endings with a branching story, you’ll want to come back for more.
•	Variety is the spice of life - Date Worms, Super Sheep, Bazookas and even the mythical Concrete Donkey
•	Local & Online Multiplayer – Compete with your friends and strangers to become the ultimate Love Guru invertebrate.
•	Love has no boundaries – Cross Platform play enabled![/b]

[img= https://www.team17.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/Websitepng1.png]

[h1]Coming to Xbox One, PlayStation 4, PC, Mobile and Virtual Boy on 1st April 2017![/h1]

notes.title: Worms Clan Wars Update - 24/10/13
notes.content:
An update to Worms Clan Wars has been released. The update will be applied automatically. This will update your game to show version number #0147 in the Main Menu. This patch is 174.2MB.

This update includes:
•	Optimised physics calculations to reduce load on CPU
•	Optimised shaders throughout the game
•	Improved performance on Intel-based graphics cards
•	Multiple changes and improvements to the single player Story experience
•	Improved AI thinking time as a result of player feedback
•	Fixed an issue where lobbies with multiple rounds was causing an issue with matchmaking
•	Fixed an issue where accepting an invite could result in being placed into an empty lobby
•	Players can now choose to zoom smoothly with the mouse wheel, rather than step through three levels of zoom
•	Players can now view Player Stats in local multiplayer games during a guest or AI turn
•	Fixed a rare issue where clan and community points weren't been recorded correctly
•	Fixed an exploit where a certain weapon could allow use of weapons in retreat time
•	Ninja Rope will now attach correctly to cavern borders
•	Changed shock range and damage cap for the Cluster Bomb 
•	Parachute can now be deployed from a Jetpack
•	Worm Charm can now be toggled between states on the jetpack
•	Changes to the way Worm Charm works. Dropping a Worm Charm now no longer ends a turn.
•	Dropping a secondary weapon from the Aqua Pack no longer ends the turn
•	Fixed an issue where having [Caps Lock] engaged resulted in shift symbols being displayed
•	Worms Firepunching into indestructible terrain will no longer become stuck in it
•	Turn timer no longer stays on zero after using the teleport gun and equipping another weapon
•	Grenade launched from a utility is now fired using the [Enter] key
•	Hangman's hat no longer acts as a moustache

notes.title: New patch with framerate improvements and other goodies!
notes.content:
[h1]Update #2 released 23/08/2013[/h1]

[b]Optimisation and Framerate Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved the vertex buffer object systems for vertex data 
[*]Optimisation pass to remove redundant state changes and unnecessary functions calls in rendering layer
[*]Altered kick-off point for water calculations to not stall the gameplay update
[/list]

[b]New Scheme Options:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Hot seat time can now be changed between 0, 3 and 5 seconds.
[*]Indestructible Terrain can now be toggled on or off. 
[*]Jet pack full can now be changed between high, medium and low.
[*]Max crates per turn can be switched between 0, 1, 2 and 3.
[/list]

[b]General Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Washing machine bug: Reduced prevalence of instances where worms become stuck in a moving pool of dynamic water (still an issue though – we’re working on it!)
[*]Fixed an issue where Steam Workshop content wasn’t appearing if files were set to read-only. 
[*]WormNet now correctly reports the number of players and active games in a channel. 
[*]Fixed an issue where subscribed landscapes were not visible without at least one user landscape. 
[*]You can now change worm loadout and team colour using a gamepad.
[*]Fixed an issue in WormNet where cancelling joining a lobby could take a long time. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the player could become stuck in the landscape editor. 
[*]Options changed after scrolling with the right mouse button are now correctly saved. 
[/list]
